- Option A: Tue Jul 27, 16:00–17:30 UTC
- Option B: Wed Jul 28, 09:00–10:30 UTC
- Option C: Thu Jul 29, 20:00–21:30 UTC (late for us, early for APAC)

Proposed internal attendees
- Ben Carter (Lead Infra, serving/runtime) — will walk serving runtime and kernel selection tradeoffs
- Grace O'Connor (Solutions/TDX lead) — runbook, preflight checklist, data flow
- Marcus Lin (Platform PM) — rollout/rollbacks and SLA discussion
Attachments: redwood_mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (stub) — quick M.A.P. draft to align milestones.

If any of those windows look off, tell us a couple alternatives and we’ll adjust. I’ll hold the Option A slot tentatively until I hear back.

Thanks — Jordan

Draft agenda (60–90m) — please flag additions or reorder:
1) 5–10m — Introductions & objectives (Jordan + Ava)
2) 15–20m — Helios current infra and expected traffic patterns (Devon/Linh)
3) 25–30m — Redwood serving runtime deep dive (Ben) — batching, KV/prefix cache, quantization tradeoffs
4) 15–20m — Security & deployment modes (Grace + Priya on Helios side) — dedicated vs private packaging, KMS/HSM considerations
5) 10–15m — Next steps: POC scope, timeline, mutual action items (all)

Pre-reqs / asks for a productive session
- Share a short pre-read with traffic profile + sample prompt set (we included pre-read-tdx-architecture.md as a stub)
- Devon/Linh: list of endpoints and typical sequence lengths for your top 3 workloads
- Priya: any specific compliance docs to look at ahead of time (SOC2 artifacts, IP controls)

Ben will prepare a focused cost/runbook sketch (token cost sensitivity + recommended batching/cache knobs) that we can walk through and leave as an artifact. Grace will bring a checklist for the 60–90m runthrough so the Helios team can replicate the preflight.

Confirming attendees from Redwood:
- Jordan Blake (SE, host)
- Ben Carter (Lead Infra)
- Grace O'Connor (TDX lead)
- Marcus Lin (Platform PM) — will join final 15m for rollout discussion

If that agenda looks good I’ll go ahead and send a calendar invite with the Google Meet link and attach the M.A.P + pre-read.

Jordan
